short_description: Vice Replay Rankings: 6 rides seen in Rockstar's own GTA 6 gameplay ("GTA VI: An Extended Look"), ranked by us. The ranking is our opinion; what each clip shows is described as it appears on screen (the street race HUD shows 6 racers, the dirt-bike race shows 12 riders). No story spoilers. Footage: official Rockstar gameplay, original audio removed.

short.headline: 6 RIDES, RANKED
short.text: I ranked the six rides in Rockstar's own GTA 6 gameplay. Number one isn't the convertible.
short.text_es: Clasifiqué los seis vehículos del gameplay oficial de GTA 6. El número uno no es el descapotable.

short.headline: #6 THE VAN
short.text: Number six, the van. It cruises a quiet street. Practical, not exciting.
short.text_es: Número seis, la furgoneta. Pasea por una calle tranquila. Práctica, no emocionante.

short.headline: #5 THE SEDAN
short.text: Five, the dark sedan on the highway at sunset. The everyday ride.
short.text_es: Cinco, el sedán oscuro en la autopista al atardecer. El de todos los días.

short.headline: #4 THE CONVERTIBLE
short.text: Four, the red convertible. Top down through the palm streets.
short.text_es: Cuatro, el descapotable rojo. Sin techo entre las palmeras.

short.headline: #3 THE DIRT BIKE
short.text: Three, the dirt bike. A twelve rider race up a canyon trail.
short.text_es: Tres, la moto de cross. Una carrera de doce pilotos por un cañón.

short.headline: #2 THE AIRBOAT
short.text: Two, the airboat, flying across the swamp. Nothing else in the footage looks like it.
short.text_es: Dos, el aerodeslizador, volando sobre el pantano. Nada más en el gameplay se le parece.

short.headline: #1 THE STREET RACER
short.text: And number one, the neon street racer, in a six car race at night.
short.text_es: Y el número uno, el coche de carreras con neón, en una carrera nocturna de seis coches.

short.headline: WHICH ONE FIRST?
short.text: Which one are you driving first? Tell me below, because
short.text_es: ¿Cuál vas a manejar primero? Dímelo abajo, porque
